body:
`avoidance_debug_dirty` is initialized as true, which means nothing will ever be emitted unless it is set to `false` first.

Also, why try and improve this at all in an otherwise 'pure' move PR? Seems a little high risk; this would have been easy to miss among all the other changes.

That is because I shifted giant amounts of debug code around that you don't see so that slipped.

This entire PR has been moved out of a bigger PR that has been torment for 2+ years due to yet-still-not-solved rendering API problems.
The debug servers also emit these same signals in `set_debug_enabled`. Pick one emission site.
This connection wasn't here previously, I think? Is this intended?

body:
Material point size where this is used is float.

This was only made real_t because at some point in the timeline, around the large-world-precision-crazy, we turned floats to real_t to humor high precision builds even when it often made zero practical sense like here.
